sources.title: OpenMed / OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-BiomedELECTRA-Large-335M-v1-mlx
sources.snippet: The model can be downloaded from Modelers.cn or the Hugging Face Hub using the model ID OpenMed/OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-BiomedELECTRA-Large-335M-v1-mlx. For Transformers, load it with AutoModelForTokenClassification and the corresponding Portuguese biomedical tokenizer.
